event_description: Fires when a user successfully creates a new account via email signup.
Fires when a user successfully signs in with email and password.
Fires when a user taps the Sign Out button on the profile page.
Fires when a user successfully submits the Add Expense form.
Fires when a user uploads a receipt image for OCR auto-fill in the expense modal.
Fires when a user sends a custom message to the AI financial adviser.
Fires when a user clicks one of the pre-defined quick-prompt buttons in the AI chat.
Fires when a user switches between the Budgets and Goals tabs on the budget page.
Fires when a user taps the Add New Goal button on the budgets/goals page.
Fires when a user taps the PDF Report download button on the profile page.
Fires when a user taps any settings option on the profile page.
